name: Kadi Bari
instructions: 1. Prepare the batter for the bari by mixing besan, salt, turmeric, and water, then deep-fry small portions in mustard oil until golden brown. 2. For the kadi, whisk curd with besan, turmeric, and water until smooth. 3. Heat mustard oil in a pan, add mustard seeds, methi seeds, hing, and dry red chilies to temper. 4. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies, then pour in the curd-besan mixture. 5. Cook on low heat, stirring constantly until thickened. 6. Drop the prepared bari into the boiling kadi and simmer for 5 minutes. 7. Garnish with fresh coriander before serving.
description: Kadi Bari is a comfort food staple in Jharkhand, often prepared during family gatherings and festivals. Its unique tangy flavor profile, derived from fermented curd and traditional mustard-based tempering, reflects the rustic and wholesome culinary traditions of the region.
